bullets: Independently lead small to medium-sized audit assignments and support larger assignments by reporting to the manager or senior manager during planning, interim, and completion stages.

Execute detailed testing and prepare audit workpapers across key FSLIs, including revenue, PPE, prepaid expenses, cash, A/R, A/P, management fees, calls and distributions, equity, and unrecorded liabilities.
Monitor work progress, manage and motivate the team to ensure all deliverables meet defined quality standards.
Identify missing information, track open issues, and ensure timely resolution.
Build and maintain strong relationships with global assurance stakeholders, serving as a key liaison for communication and issue resolution.
Effectively managed two client engagements concurrently throughout the year, including peak periods. Demonstrated proficiency by completing three busy seasons within the organization.
Performed substantive testing procedures in the areas of statement of assets & liabilities and statement of operations, for example, equity, FS tie-out, management fee, revenue, carried interest.
Executed assigned client engagements from start to finish, which included planning, directing, materiality, risk assessment, scoping, workflow management, and completing assigned tasks.
Discussed the queries and issues faced during the audit with senior managers, directors of PwC US, and clients.
Conducted quality checks on all deliverables to ensure they were consistent with the quality parameters.
Provided coaching, guidance, and walkthroughs to newly joined team members to familiarize them with the work.
Filed income tax returns, TDS, TCS, payroll, and prepared financial statements of private limited companies and partnership firms.
Handled internal audit & statutory audit assignments of manufacturing and trading companies and concurrent audits of nationalized banks.
Ensured GST compliance, including filing various GST returns and assisting in GST audits.
Completed Excel training program conducted by BIZWIZ.CO.IN.

Received Spotlight and Territory Spot awards for showcasing unwavering commitment towards client service, and the Knowledge Accelerator award for spending considerable time & effort in training others.
Participated in PwC SDC’s CSR activities and received a CSR Certificate for contributing to initiatives in dance, art, and yoga.
